title: Edition zero: before the open
summary: Drafted from Friday's closes. Enter Monday at the open, half-size in TSMC, Nvidia and Korea until TSMC reports on Thursday. Superseded on 12 Oct by decisions D-005 and D-006: full-size entry, see the plan update.

title: Plan update: full-size entry, IREN, linker sleeve
summary: Everything is bought in full at Monday's open (D-006). IREN replaces Itau at 4% (D-005), EWZ is 6%, the Brazil reserve 5%, and the defensive sleeve is an 8% index-linked gilt fund. Severe-shock loss 19.24% against the 18% limit, accepted by the owner.

title: Korea breaks lower; first morning after entry
summary: Entry recorded at 12 Oct opens. Portfolio -0.98% since entry vs SPY -0.09% (alpha -0.89). KOSPI -5.47% to 6,035.34, 0.6% above the 6,000 trigger; LKOR near its review level once Tuesday's fall feeds through. CPI Wed, TSMC Thu.

title: Korea steadies above 6,000; CPI today, TSMC tomorrow
summary: Portfolio -1.11% since entry vs SPY -0.10% (alpha -1.01). KOSPI closed 6,035.35 on Tue and about 6,104 Wed, above the 6,000 trigger. LKOR -5.87% since entry, 4.6% above its review level. CPI 13:30 UK, TSMC Thu.

title: KOSPI closes below 6,000 after an 8% fall; proposal to sell LKOR
summary: KOSPI about 5,533 (-7.9%) breaches the 6,000 trigger, a named LKOR thesis-breaker. Portfolio -3.95% since entry vs SPY -1.18% (alpha -2.77) after hot CPI and a 4.3% chip fall. Proposal: sell LKOR in full, owner to decide. TSMC reported in range; Market view with five calls.

title: KOSPI rebounds but stays below 6,000; LKOR sale still pending; -6% step 0.9 points away
summary: Model NAV -5.09% since entry vs SPY -0.90% (alpha -4.19); the -6% ladder step (GBP 94,000) is 0.91 points away. KOSPI 5,554 then 5,668, both under 6,000; LKOR below its review level on an unverified price; standing proposal to sell it. Market view with five calls; three of yesterday's five hit, two still open.

title: IREN closes below its review level after a 3.8% chip fall; -6% step about 0.5 points away
summary: Derived NAV about GBP 94,530 (-5.47%) vs SPY -2.00% (alpha -3.47) after Nasdaq -2.15% and SOX -3.83% on Friday. IREN closed 26.99, below its 28 review level: proposal to sell half, owner to decide. KOSPI closed 5,768 on Monday, still under 6,000. CoreWeave closed 61.39 (-11.9%), CDS about 1,117bp. Market view with five calls; two of the 16 Oct calls hit, one missed, two open.

title: I got IREN wrong: what I learned from a 26% loss in a week
summary: Owner sold IREN in full after its close of 26.99 below the 28 review level, -25.7% since entry. Why it fell (neocloud credit stress, CoreWeave bonds above 16%, chip sell-off), the mistake (kept 4% against a 3% dissent on an unconfirmed contract report) and five lessons. Written for a social post.
